newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBS END LOWER AS INVESTORS REMAIN SIDELINED.
newsitem.headline: JGBS END LOWER AS INVESTORS REMAIN SIDELINED.

text.p: The key September 10-year Japanese government bond futures contract ended lower on Tuesday due to profit-taking and selling of long-term cash bonds.

"The September was dragged down by profit-taking above 126.50. It was, however, supported on the downside due to buying on dips at just above 126.40," a trader for a trust bank's securities unit said.
Some investors were detected selling long-term cash bonds and buying medium-term bonds, which also dampened sentiment, a city bank trader said.
